stepAllOrderLemma.name: original-flat-logistic-C-infinity
stepAllOrderLemma.allOrdersProof: Induction under the displayed recurrence expresses every positive-order derivative as a finite Laurent polynomial in t,1-t times sigma(1-sigma). Near 0, sigma<=exp(-1/t^2+4) for t<=1/2; near 1 use 1-sigma and reflection. For every fixed m, t^-m exp(-1/t^2) tends to 0: with x=1/t^2 and integer k>m/2, exp(x)>=x^k/k!. Thus all one-sided derivatives vanish at both endpoints. The zero/one exterior branches glue to a real C-infinity function. This is induction for arbitrary order, not extrapolation of the finite controls.
